name: name comment: 国家名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: enabled comment: 是否启用 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency_code comment: default: enum_values: index: - name: name comment: 商家名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 商家状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: user to: address type: 1:N label: 拥有多个地址 color: '#1565C0' penwidth: 1.8 - from: country to: address type: 1:N label: 地址所属国家 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: country_address_config type: '1:1' label: 国家字段配置 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: address_field_validation_rules type: 1:N label: 校验规则(按国家) color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: postal_code_mapping type: 1:N label: 邮编数据 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: administrative_division type: 1:N label: 行政区划数据 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: administrative_division to: administrative_division type: 1:N label: 父子层级(自引用) color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.2 style: dashed - from: address_field_meta to: country_address_config type: 1:N label: field_config引用字段元数据 color: '#2E7D32' penwidth: 1.4 style: dashed - from: address_field_meta to: address_field_validation_rules type: 1:N label: field_name引用元数据 color: '#2E7D32' penwidth: 1.4 - from: merchant to: delivery_restriction type: 1:N label: 商家自有规则 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: delivery_restriction type: 1:N label: 国家配送限制 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: delivery_restriction to: delivery_restriction_merchant_opt type: 1:N label: 平台规则→商家开关 color: '#1565C0' penwidth: 1.4 - from: merchant to: delivery_restriction_merchant_opt type: 1:N label: 商家opt-in/out记录 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: address_field_meta to: administrative_division type: 1:N label: admin_division_level映射 color: '#2E7D32' penwidth: 1.2 style: dashed design_rules: superset_fields: 超集字段设计：数据库包含所有国家字段，通过country_address_config控制展示 field_registry: address_field_meta是字段的单一事实来源，后台配置页从此表读取可选字段列表 admin_division_mapping: admin_division_level数据驱动行政区划映射：state_province→L1, city→L2, district→L3，不硬编码 market_integration: 国家可用性引用market模块，地址库不独立维护国家列表 frontend_i18n: 前端多语言采用i18n方案，数据库不存储多语言字段 name_split: recipient_first_name + recipient_last_name 拆分存储，支持支付AVS和物流API name_concat: recipient_name 冗余存储拼接结果，拼接顺序由country_address_config.name_format控制 address_type_enum: 'address_type 枚举值: shipping, billing' verified_source_enum: 'verified_source 枚举值: google, usps, loqate' soft_delete: 地址数据支持软删除(CCPA要求可彻底删除) encryption: phone_number, recipient_first_name, recipient_last_name 字段 AES-256 加密存储 place_id_dedup: 通过 place_id 做地址去重(V1.1) mvp_scope: 'MVP只启用美国(US)，预留字段: alternate_phone_*, district, building_name, verified_*' snapshot_ownership: 订单地址快照(order_address_snapshot)由订单模块管理，不在地址库ER图中体现 validation_execute_on: execute_on区分前后端：client=前端实时校验, server=后端提交校验, both=前后端都执行 validation_severity: severity区分拦截级别：error=硬拦截阻止保存, warning=软提示允许继续 multi_rule_validation: 同一字段支持多条校验规则，按priority顺序执行，命中首个失败即返回对应error_message rule_type_enum: 'rule_type 枚举值: pattern(正则格式), length(长度范围), custom(自定义正则)' required_level_in_rules: 'required_level 统一在 address_field_validation_rules 中管理，枚举值: required/optional/conditional' field_config_structure: 'field_config JSON结构: {field_name: {enabled: bool}}，enabled=是否在该国启用此字段' error_message_i18n_only: 校验规则错误提示统一使用 error_message_i18n_key，不存储硬编码文案 merchant_isolation: 配送限制支持多商家隔离：merchant_id=NULL为平台级规则，有值为商家自有规则(仅该商家生效) delivery_restriction_scope_enum: 'scope 枚举值: all_merchants(全部商家含自营启用), third_party_default_on(三方商家启用默认开启), third_party_default_off(三方商家启用默认关闭), self_operated_only(仅自营启用)' fixed_rule_immutable: '固定规则(is_fixed=true): PO Box/军事地址，系统内置不可增删改，平台仅可调整scope' merchant_state_only: 商家自有规则(merchant_custom)仅支持州选择(match_method=state_select)，不支持正则/关键词，降低配置门槛 merchant_opt_mechanism: 商家对平台可选规则的开关通过delivery_restriction_merchant_opt表管理：scope=third_party_default_on时无记录=启用，scope=third_party_default_off时无记录=关闭 scope_enforcement: scope=all_merchants时平台强制所有商家启用，商家不可关闭；scope=self_operated_only时仅自营生效，不展示给三方商家 delivery_check_union: 地址校验时取并集：平台强制规则 ∪ 商家已启用的可选规则 ∪ 商家自有规则，命中任一即拦截 remark_visibility: 平台规则remark对商家可见(帮助理解规则用途)；商家自有规则remark仅商家自己可见 category_future: category字段预留品类维度限制能力，MVP阶段固定为全品类(all) public_data_ownership: 公共数据(国家地址配置/行政区划/邮编)由超级管理员维护，不区分商家 mvp_merchant_strategy: MVP阶段Looply自营，delivery_restriction.merchant_id全部为NULL。后续引入商家时只需加筛选和权限控制
